description: Shutdown a selected simulator or emulator. On Limrun, delete a created instance or release an attachment. Apps and data on a deleted instance are lost. A Limrun connection without an instance fails with DEVICE_NOT_FOUND and details.reason provider_instance_unallocated and creates nothing. Times out after 90s.

device.description: Device name; ids go in udid or serial.

includeCost.description: Add agent cost (cost.wallClockMs, …) to the result, returned as JSON text.

mcpOutputFormat.description: Result text: compact optimized (default) or the full result as JSON (larger).

responseLevel.description: Result detail: digest (smallest) or full (largest), as JSON; default is compact text.

serial.description: Android, HarmonyOS, or Vega VVD serial.

name: shutdown
